subject: Media Literacy
title: Partisan Media Ecosystems
description: A quick win: understand Partisan Media Ecosystems.

hook.text: A conservative and a liberal can consume news all day and never encounter the same story, source, or perspective.

buildup.text: Partisan media ecosystems are self-contained networks where outlets cite each other and ignore outside sources.

discovery.text: Research shows conservative and liberal media ecosystems have very little overlap in stories or sources cited.

twist.text: Inside these ecosystems, certain 'facts' become accepted truths that are unknown or dismissed outside them.

climax.text: When people consume news from only one ecosystem, they literally live in different informational realities.

punchline.text: Same country. Same events. Completely different news.

quiz.question: What characterizes partisan media ecosystems?
options: They share all the same stories
Self-contained networks that cite each other and ignore outside sources
